title: National foundation + A&M specialization
decision: Broad national learning with disproportionate A&M specialization; exact statistical decomposition remains revisable.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Scientific BAS headline definition
decision: BAS headline is P(A&M performs ≥7 points worse than strictly valid pregame expected margin), with ≥3/14/21 severity support.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: SportsDataverse + CFBD public foundation
decision: Use SportsDataverse as primary historical/PBP foundation and CFBD as primary supplemental source, subject to Wave06 current research.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: PFF deferred and non-blocking
decision: PFF is optional future enrichment only; core plan operates without it.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Point-in-time known-at architecture
decision: Every historical prediction is reconstructed from observations eligible before prediction timestamp.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Immutable raw + dated observations
decision: Raw evidence is immutable and mutable state is represented as effective-dated observations/snapshots.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Canonical IDs separate from source IDs
decision: Internal canonical entities are stable; source IDs/aliases remain mapped evidence.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Empirical feature lifecycle
decision: LLM/domain intuition may propose; PIT walk-forward experiments, ablation and stability decide production feature status.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: FBS/FCS/lower-division hierarchy
decision: FBS full, FCS meaningful secondary, lower divisions increasingly coarse priors with uncertainty.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Separate national history from current-team evidence
decision: Old games teach general football; direct current-team state is driven by current roster/regime/continuity/recent evidence.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Player/replacement availability architecture
decision: Injury impact depends on player value, replacement, usage, availability/effectiveness, matchup and uncertainty.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Role-conditioned hierarchical coaching
decision: Coach careers use effective-dated role episodes and residual/partial-pooled effects; no static generic coach rating.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Resources as conditional upstream capacity
decision: Resources inform priors/expectation and BAS efficiency; avoid direct dollar bonus/double counting and preserve public/private asymmetry.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Pure-football + market-augmented lanes
decision: Keep market-free forecast separate from timestamp-safe market-augmented forecast.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Canonical game as split unit
decision: All representations of a game remain in same train/validation/test fold.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Joint-score coherence requirement
decision: Win, score, margin, spread-cover and BAS residual distributions must be mathematically coherent.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Governed autonomous research
decision: Research agents may propose/run approved experiments but cannot alter judging rules or directly promote themselves.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Local-first compute
decision: Phases 1–4 target local Ryzen/32GB/RTX5060; remote GPU optional later.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Five-phase framework
decision: Foundation → advanced football intelligence → A&M specialization → production/autonomy → advanced research, refinable if dependencies justify.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: No large raw data in repo packs
decision: Repository holds acquisition code/contracts/tiny fixtures/manifests/docs, not full raw lake/model binaries.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Adaptive 25-wave plan
decision: Wave missions are minimum centers of gravity; later scopes may be revised while retaining exactly 25 waves.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Numerical source-log chronology
decision: Wave 01 reads chat logs by numeric filename sequence 001→020, not ZIP member order.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Content-based reconnaissance identity
decision: Internal pack edition/required structure/hashes define identity; host copy suffixes do not invalidate the artifact.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Authoritative recon integrity manifest
decision: Use final/manifests/FINAL_FILE_MANIFEST.csv + FINAL_FILE_HASHES.sha256 as authoritative; root PACK_MANIFEST self-entry mismatch is documented non-blocking self-reference artifact.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Deterministic services for deterministic work
decision: Prefer normal Python services for deterministic ingestion/validation/state jobs; use LLMs where language/research reasoning adds value.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: No unverified pretrained-model dependency
decision: Train/evaluate our own models; external public models may be benchmarks/reference only when currently verified.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Learned home-field effect
decision: Estimate partial-pooled residual home/venue effects; no hard-coded Kyle Field bonus.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Learned transfer translation
decision: No fixed conference transfer penalty; learn destination translation from historical cohorts/context.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Effective-dated rule-era registry
decision: Version material NCAA rule changes and affected feature definitions; season alone is insufficient when explicit versioning is needed.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Immutable market/prediction snapshots
decision: Preserve market and prediction observations at each forecast timestamp; never overwrite earlier state.
notes: Baseline decision; Level-B portions remain revisable through evidence-backed ADR.

title: Minimal src-layout until Wave03
decision: Use an installable src/aggie_analytics package scaffold but do not create speculative future domain/service packages before Wave03 architecture comparison.
notes: Operational structure accepted; domain boundaries remain explicitly open.

title: Python 3.12 preferred local baseline
decision: Prefer CPython 3.12 locally while allowing 3.11-3.13 in starter metadata until actual ML/data dependency compatibility is measured.
notes: Revisit when production dependency stack is selected.

title: Portable venv/pip baseline
decision: Python venv plus pip is the required portable bootstrap; optional faster environment managers may accelerate but are not mandatory.
notes: Revisable if measured workflow benefit justifies another required manager.

title: Standard-library deterministic pack tooling
decision: Wave pack verification, manifesting, safe ZIP handling and packaging use Python standard library and normalized ZIP metadata.
evidence_basis: W01 manifest issue; cumulative integrity requirements
notes: Core safety behavior is protected; implementation may evolve.

title: Machine-readable hydration allowlist
decision: Hydration content is generated from configs/hydration_manifest.json plus generated HYDRATE_FIRST/PACK_BINDING/hash evidence.
notes: Do not silently expand hydration with full repo.

title: Minimal cross-platform CI now; full CI Wave23
decision: Create Windows/Linux Python 3.12 repository-integrity CI now; defer complete security/dependency/deployment/observability CI to Wave23.
notes: Expand earlier only if dependencies require it.

title: Codex worktree contract without guessed external config
decision: Use repository-local task/worktree contracts and codex/<epic>-<task>; do not commit unverified external Codex config schemas.
notes: Tool config may be added after schema verification.

title: No Docker/database/orchestrator commitment in W02
decision: Do not add Docker, database services or orchestration frameworks solely for repository setup; evaluate them in their architecture/operations waves.
evidence_basis: Master no-cargo-cult rule; W02 adaptive review
notes: This is a deferral, not a permanent rejection.

title: Safe prior-wave verification before extraction
decision: Verify binding hash/next-wave and reject unsafe archive members before extraction; future sessions should use executable verification tooling.
notes: Protected pack-integrity behavior.

title: Offline-first modular monolith
decision: Use one modular local application/repository as the default Phases 1-4 deployment; split services only on demonstrated operational need.
evidence_basis: W03 alternative comparison; local hardware; simplicity rule
notes: Revisable if independent scaling/security/latency evidence appears.

title: Immutable snapshot serving
decision: Pregame API/dashboard serves immutable forecast snapshots rather than synchronous online feature construction/model execution.
notes: W22 may choose UI/API technology without changing snapshot boundary.

title: Parquet plus DuckDB early analytical stack
decision: Prefer native immutable raw files, partitioned Parquet analytical zones and DuckDB local querying for early phases.
evidence_basis: Master storage defaults; local hardware; W03 comparison
notes: Physical implementation remains evidence-revisable.

title: PostgreSQL deferred behind storage port
decision: Do not make PostgreSQL mandatory now; W07/W22/W23 may adopt a relational adapter if transactional/concurrent workflows justify it.
notes: Supersedes any implication that PostgreSQL is mandatory from initial defaults.

title: Provider ports and canonical boundary
decision: Keep source-provider acquisition/parsing behind adapters; provider schemas do not directly define football/model interfaces.
evidence_basis: Recon canonical source rules; W03 boundaries
notes: Source adapters remain replaceable after Wave06 source research.

title: PIT state as hard feature gateway
decision: All historical/inference features obtain mutable observations through explicit as-of/PIT state contracts.
notes: W08 owns detailed implementation, not whether the gateway exists.

title: Explicit national-to-A&M specialization contract
decision: National foundation and A&M high-resolution specialization communicate through an explicit representation/adjustment contract; A&M cannot fork canonical truth.
evidence_basis: Protected national+A&M objective; recon source precedence
notes: W14/W16 select residual/multitask/MoE implementation.

title: Forecast assembly owns cross-target coherence
decision: Use a forecast-distribution assembly boundary to keep score, margin, win and BAS-related outputs coherent.
notes: W16 selects statistical family.

title: Research plane isolated from protected production
decision: Research can produce candidates/proposals but enters production only through protected evaluation/promotion gates.
notes: No research component is a required import of production forecast runtime.

title: LLM assistive plane only
decision: LLMs may assist evidence extraction/research/explanations but are not required for deterministic core forecast refresh and cannot decide PIT/promotion rules.
notes: Future LLM use must preserve evidence/provenance and deterministic validation.

title: Read-serving boundary cannot query raw/model internals
decision: Serving surfaces consume immutable forecast snapshots and lineage, not raw provider/PIT/feature/model internals.
notes: W22 implementation must honor this boundary.

title: Future live plane isolated
decision: Future in-game modeling is a separate chronological lane and cannot feed same-game pregame features.
notes: Phase5 may reuse pregame priors through an explicit one-way interface.

title: Stable semantic namespaces without empty implementation sprawl
decision: Define future core/data/features/models/forecasting/tamu/evaluation/research/serving namespace ownership but instantiate only architecture contracts in W03.
evidence_basis: W02 anti-premature-freezing decision; W03 package review
notes: ADR-031 is refined: logical boundaries are now accepted, implementation packages remain created by owning waves.

title: No distributed infrastructure requirement for pregame v1
decision: Do not require Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, online feature stores or microservices for the current pregame architecture.
notes: These are not permanently banned; later evidence may justify them.

title: Machine-readable architecture registry
decision: Maintain component/interface/data-zone/dependency rules in configs/architecture_registry.json and validate them in tests.
notes: Registry captures logical architecture, not all later domain schemas.

title: Separate requirement class/lifecycle/evidence status
decision: Track Level A/B/C class, requirement lifecycle, and acceptance evidence state independently.
notes: Prevents a mandatory future requirement from being mislabeled PASS before evidence exists.

title: Machine-readable acceptance registry and full coverage
decision: Maintain acceptance controls, thresholds and requirement/ADR/risk mappings in machine-readable registries validated by repository tooling.
evidence_basis: Master acceptance/traceability mandate; W04 adaptive review
notes: Representation may evolve through ADR without weakening exact coverage.

title: No fabricated quantitative acceptance thresholds
decision: Record unknown numerical thresholds as TBD_BY_EVIDENCE/TBD_BY_BENCHMARK and assign owning waves; do not invent false precision in W04.
notes: W17/W19-W23 own evidence-derived values.

title: Protected temporal/leakage controls fail closed and block release
decision: PIT ambiguity, leakage, canonical-game split safety and BAS expected-margin temporal failures block affected data/model/forecast release.
notes: No waiver by research agent.

title: Protected test seal and precommitted promotion criteria
decision: Freeze protected periods and promotion criteria before inspecting protected results; protected results are not tuning feedback.
notes: W17 implements detailed protocol.

title: Acceptance uses multiple evidence modes
decision: Use static/unit/integration/replay/scientific/benchmark/manual evidence according to requirement nature rather than forcing every requirement into a unit test.
notes: Manual decisions must still be traceable.

title: Explicit trust boundary and fail-closed untrusted inputs
decision: Treat external files/APIs/pages/LLM extraction as untrusted data; validate before canonical use and never execute source-provided code/instructions.
evidence_basis: Security hardening; existing safe ZIP tooling
notes: Provider-specific controls are added in W06-W09.

title: Forecast reproducibility is lineage-replay based
decision: Reproducibility means immutable linked data/feature/model/config/environment evidence sufficient to replay/explain a forecast, not merely rerunning latest code.
notes: Exact storage schemas remain later-wave work.

title: Performance budgets require target-hardware benchmark evidence
decision: Do not freeze arbitrary runtime/RAM/storage limits before representative/full workload benchmarks on the target local machine.
notes: W19-W23 populate performance thresholds.

title: Bidirectional acceptance traceability across REQ/ADR/RISK
decision: Every requirement, ADR and risk maps to acceptance controls so changes/failures identify affected governance objects.
notes: Validated by tools/validate_acceptance.py.

title: Capability phases are organizational, waves remain execution authority
decision: Use five capability phases to organize work while the exactly-25-wave program remains the execution/control sequence.
notes: Prevents phase labels from silently creating/reordering waves.

title: Stable epic/task IDs and machine-readable WBS
decision: Use stable EPIC/TASK IDs in CSV/JSON as the canonical implementation backlog.

title: DAG/gates instead of fabricated calendar schedule
decision: Represent implementation order using dependencies/readiness gates; do not invent hour/date estimates.

title: Critical path means dependency-critical spine
decision: Critical path is a dependency/gating spine, not a duration-optimized CPM calculation without task durations.

title: Five complexity classes describe coupling and risk
decision: C1-C5 classify scope/coupling/uncertainty/protected-contract risk, not elapsed time.

title: Mandatory W06 implementation replan gate
decision: W06 source research must explicitly revalidate source-dependent future tasks before they become ready.

title: Source-dependent tasks provisional until W06
decision: Mark W07+ source/schema-dependent tasks PLANNED_REVALIDATE_AFTER_W06.

title: Codex packets are bounded implementation slices
decision: Use work packets spanning coherent task slices with outputs/tests/acceptance/stop conditions; avoid micro-handoff prompt fragmentation.

title: Serialize unfrozen shared-contract mutations
decision: Only one workstream mutates an unfrozen shared contract at a time; parallelism targets independent modules or stable interfaces.

title: Bounded adaptive parallelism over fixed concurrency
decision: Run as many independent worktrees as dependencies/local resources allow; do not hard-code a concurrency count that ignores current constraints.

title: Evidence gate required before DONE/integration
decision: Task completion requires required test/evidence controls, not code presence alone.

title: W05 backlog is revisable evidence-controlled plan
decision: Treat W05 ordering/task details as a strong implementation baseline that can change through W06/later evidence-backed revisions without losing IDs/history.

title: Official availability reports are primary where policy covers the game
decision: Use versioned official conference/CFP availability reports as primary evidence when covered; aggregators/media remain fallback/enrichment.

title: Issued weather model runs replace observed-weather proxies for historical forecast state
decision: Historical forecast weather uses NOAA/Open-Meteo archived issued runs with model/init/lead/valid-time provenance; observations are separate.

title: Timestamped market providers are optional market-lane enrichment
decision: Use timestamped market snapshot providers when justified; preserve pure-football lane and never make paid market history a core dependency.

title: Official lower-division statistics strengthen bounded priors
decision: Use NCAA FCS/DII/DIII, NAIA and NJCAA official statistics for bounded opponent/transfer priors while avoiding equal-resolution recursive modeling.

title: Rule era expands to effective-dated regulatory environment
decision: Represent material roster, eligibility and transfer governance changes alongside playing rules using publication/adoption/effective dates.

title: Derived data requires explicit upstream provenance
decision: SportsDataverse/CFBD and similar derived data retain upstream publisher/source lineage and are not treated as independent corroboration when sharing upstreams.

title: Commercial advanced data remains adapter-isolated and nonblocking
decision: Commercial injury/live/charting/tracking providers are optional adapters/research lanes until value/cost/rights justify promotion.

title: Private-school resource proxies remain semantically separate
decision: IRS/institutional proxy evidence may reduce missingness but cannot be presented as football-specific spending without direct evidence.

title: Current source research does not require distributed service architecture
decision: Retain W03 modular monolith/snapshot serving; source diversity is handled through adapters and temporal evidence contracts.

title: Mutable official reports require publication/version observations
decision: Availability, rankings and edited official pages are stored as versioned observations with publication/first-known/retrieval semantics rather than overwritten current state.

title: W06 replan clears but does not freeze future source choices forever
decision: Clear W07 readiness using W06 evidence while retaining W24 source refresh and future evidence-backed source substitutions.

title: Public access is not redistribution permission
decision: Raw data may remain local; public repository inclusion requires explicit rights/terms/attribution decision independent of URL accessibility.

title: Opaque prefixed UUID surrogate is current canonical-ID representation default
decision: Use type-prefixed UUID4 hex as the dependency-free representation default for surrogate canonical IDs; the protected invariants are opacity/stability/no source coupling and the representation may change before real IDs are materialized.

title: Source mappings are first-class append-only decision records
decision: Represent source-system/type/key to canonical mappings as auditable records with evidence, method, state and supersession rather than overwriting a lookup table in place.

title: Direct source IDs are mapping evidence only after contract validation
decision: A provider ID may support deterministic mapping only after its semantics/uniqueness/scope are validated; canonical IDs never become aliases for unverified source IDs.

title: Fuzzy/name matching is candidate generation, not canonical truth
decision: Disable fuzzy auto-accept in W07; only verified existing/direct/crosswalk mapping classes auto-accept, while ambiguous candidates enter review.

title: Human identity is separated from roles, teams and mutable attributes
decision: Player transfers and coach role/team changes are episodes/observations linked to stable human identity.

title: Identity corrections use merge/split/supersession history
decision: Never destructively delete/reuse assigned canonical identities; corrections preserve old decisions/data versions and add redirects or split mappings.

title: Game identity represents the underlying contest, not current schedule fields
decision: Retain game identity through supported reschedule/venue/status changes; create a new identity for replacement matchups; annotate forfeit/vacated results without changing identity.
evidence_basis: Master game edge cases; recon join contracts

title: Mutable source evidence uses layered identity
decision: Separate source system, resource, publication version, raw capture and parsed source observation so edited reports/pages and retrieval events remain reconstructible.

title: PostgreSQL remains deferred for canonical identity workflow
decision: Current single-writer append-only mapping/decision workflow does not justify a relational server; retain Parquet/DuckDB default behind storage ports and reopen on real concurrent transactional need.

title: Review queue is a derived view over immutable candidate/decision events
decision: Do not require a mutable queue table; derive current unresolved/review state from append-only candidates and latest non-superseded decisions.

title: No graph database is required for canonical relationships
decision: Represent identity relationships/episodes as normalized tables/contracts; adopt graph infrastructure only if a later measured workload justifies it.

title: W07 identity contracts are frozen for W08 but implementation benchmark remains W19
decision: W08 may rely on canonical identity/evidence layers; W19 still owns materialized resolver/storage throughput benchmarks and any labeled fuzzy auto-accept threshold.

title: Bitemporal knowledge and validity axes
decision: Represent public knowability separately from real-world validity/effectivity; both participate in PIT selection.
evidence_basis: Recon temporal policies; W07 evidence identity; W08 synthetic fixtures
notes: Protects against publication/effective conflation.

title: first_known evidence policy
decision: Use defensible first-known evidence; retrieval is conservative fallback when earlier public availability cannot be proven.
notes: No guessed historic publication time.

title: prediction_eligible_at is derived metadata
decision: Treat prediction_eligible_at as policy-versioned derived/cache metadata, never a raw source truth or sufficient sole predicate.
notes: Validity/domain/revision checks remain required.

title: Deterministic fail-closed as-of selector
decision: As-of selection applies domain ban, knowledge cutoff, target validity, revision state and deterministic precedence; ambiguity fails closed.
notes: Protected gateway behavior.

title: Revision replay uses as-known version
decision: Later source corrections/reports do not rewrite historical snapshots; select versions known at the cutoff.
notes: Append-only correction lineage retained.

title: Immutable cutoff object
decision: Forecast/training/replay cutoffs are immutable versioned lineage records including target, lane, policy and data snapshot.
notes: Enables reproducible replay.

title: Issued weather run contract
decision: Weather pregame evidence requires exact model initialization/availability/valid-time lineage; realized weather cannot substitute.
evidence_basis: W06 weather research; recon weather safety
notes: Archive coverage remains later materialization work.

title: Availability policy/version contract
decision: Official availability is versioned and policy/game scoped; noncoverage means UNKNOWN and later versions affect later cutoffs only.
notes: Supports W12 materialization.

title: Market labels are descriptive not temporal authority
decision: Opening/current/closing labels never override provider observation knowability; pure and market lanes remain separate.
notes: Timestamp is authoritative for eligibility.

title: Regulatory/resource dual-time contract
decision: Regulatory effective intervals and resource reporting periods are separate from publication/first-known time.
notes: Season/fiscal labels are insufficient.

title: Retrospective evidence fail-closed
decision: Retrospective/current pages require dated corroboration before historical PIT use.
notes: Official status alone is insufficient.

title: Completed-game chronology for historical aggregates
decision: Current/future-game outputs are banned; prior outputs require game completion and source knowability before cutoff.
notes: Applies to training replay and features.

title: PIT gateway becomes protected feature boundary
decision: CMP-006 feature construction may consume temporal state only through CMP-005 PIT gateway contracts.
notes: Direct mutable-source feature access is forbidden.

title: Synthetic PIT PASS is not production data proof
decision: Synthetic leakage tests validate contract behavior but real historical materialization/replay remains later evidence.
notes: Prevents overclaiming W08 completion.

title: Raw-field registry is metadata not production feature lifecycle
decision: Registry presence and W09 handoff may authorize W10 experimentation only; W10 evidence owns feature promotion.

title: Stable source-scoped raw-field IDs
decision: Assign stable RF IDs to source/dataset/field semantics; rename/repurpose creates new identity rather than reusing an old ID.

title: Recon temporal classification has precedence over scanner heuristics
decision: Observed schema facts may enrich metadata but cannot downgrade verified temporal/leakage classifications.

title: Unmaterialized W06 endpoint schemas remain pending
decision: Represent unknown schemas explicitly instead of fabricating field inventories.

title: Sample missingness remains non-population evidence
decision: Preserve representative sample profiles separately and require later snapshot population profiling.

title: Exact-name overlap creates review clusters only
decision: Do not semantically merge fields based on names; require compatible semantics/grain/unit/time/join evidence.

title: Join paths require canonical identity semantics
decision: Presence of key/name fields is insufficient for durable cross-source joins.

title: Schema scanner separates documented and observed type
decision: Observed type is scan evidence; it does not mutate documented contracts or prior schema versions.

title: Standard-library scanner core with optional Parquet plugin
decision: CSV/JSON/JSONL work without new dependency; Parquet uses pyarrow only when already approved/installed.

title: Nested JSON uses deterministic dotted paths
decision: Dotted nested paths are the W09 default and may be revised only through versioned schema contract.

title: W09 W10-candidate handoff remains behind W08 PIT gateway
decision: Candidate permission never bypasses W08 as-of selection, source lineage or later W10 empirical lifecycle.

title: W09 feature-registry gate frozen for W10
decision: W10 may rely on W09 registry/handoff contracts but owns transformations, screening, ablation and promotion.

title: Target-specific six-state feature lifecycle
decision: Use CORE/SUPPORTED/CONDITIONAL/EXPERIMENTAL/REJECTED/BANNED per target with append-only decisions.
notes: State semantics frozen; empirical state assignments remain evidence-driven.

title: No universal rolling-window default
decision: Rolling/EWMA/recency parameters are experiment candidates rather than one hard-coded football intuition window.
notes: Concrete winning windows remain empirical.

title: Strict-prior transform semantics
decision: Pregame lag/rolling/trend transforms exclude target/same-game observations by construction.
notes: Protected transform rule.

title: Multi-method screening instead of single importance ranking
decision: Use staged PIT/data-quality/redundancy/regularization/permutation/ablation/stability evidence; no single importance statistic promotes.
notes: Specific models/estimators remain revisable.

title: Univariate association is exploratory
decision: Correlation/mutual information may generate evidence but cannot independently approve a feature.
notes: Prevents association ranking from becoming production truth.

title: Family ablation and temporal stability are promotion evidence
decision: Production promotion requires chronological family ablation and stability evidence under the target plan.
notes: Numeric threshold remains THR-007 TBD.

title: Market candidate lane remains isolated
decision: Market-derived feature candidates are market-augmented-only and never contaminate the pure-football lane.
notes: Preserves market-independent forecasts.

title: Lifecycle decisions are append-only evidence records
decision: Promotions/demotions/rejections retain evidence/history; reopened rejected candidates use a new experiment/version.
notes: No silent state rewrites.

title: BANNED is structural, not low importance
decision: BANNED candidates require safety/governance correction before experimentation; good model scores cannot override leakage/rights bans.
notes: Separates safety from empirical rejection.

title: Real feature promotion deferred to empirical owner waves
decision: W10 freezes machinery and synthetic semantics but makes zero real-data promotions; W17/W19 evidence is required.
notes: Prevents synthetic tests from becoming claimed predictive evidence.

title: Explicit interactions only; no combinatorial explosion
decision: Interactions are registered hypotheses with lineage and evaluation; do not brute-force all pairwise interactions.
notes: Can expand when evidence justifies.

title: Standard-library reference feature machinery at W10
decision: Keep transform/lifecycle reference code dependency-light now; W16-W19 may add approved statistical/ML libraries for empirical pipelines.
notes: Not a rejection of sklearn/XGBoost/etc.; selection belongs later.

title: Separate prior/underlying/available/form state
decision: Team state explicitly separates prior, underlying, available strength and current-form evidence.
evidence_basis: Source chat distinction; W11 state contract

title: Team state is immutable PIT snapshot
decision: Team-state snapshots are cutoff/version bound and consume only W08-eligible evidence.

title: Composite Week-1 prior with no frozen component weights
decision: Register multiple prior components but leave their weights empirical.
evidence_basis: Source chat early-season prior; resource strategy

title: Early-season blend schedule remains empirical
decision: Compare prior/observed blend candidates chronologically; do not hard-code week-specific weights.

title: National training utility differs from current-team relevance
decision: Old games may remain nationally useful while being heavily downweighted for present-team identity/state.

title: Recency/regime/change-point representations remain candidates
decision: Freeze candidate families and interfaces, not a winning formula or decay parameter.

title: Change points shrink/inflate uncertainty before hard reset
decision: Do not automatically discard history after staff/QB/scheme/performance change; reset only if later evidence supports it.

title: Bounded FBS/FCS/lower-division hierarchy
decision: FBS full, FCS strong secondary, then progressively coarser lower-division priors.

title: Cross-division translation is data-driven with uncertainty
decision: No fixed FCS/D-II/D-III penalty; translation functions/priors require empirical cross-level evidence.

title: Resources are upstream prior candidates
decision: Evaluate reliable resource variables mainly as program/preseason priors, not weekly points bonuses.

title: W12 owns detailed available-strength player adjustment
decision: W11 freezes the available-strength port but leaves player availability/effectiveness/usage/replacement mechanics to W12.

title: Team-state subsystem stays inside modular monolith
decision: Add a logical Python team_state package/contract; no new deployable service/database is justified.

title: W11 gate freezes semantics, not empirical parameterization
decision: Downstream waves may rely on interfaces; real winner/parameter selection remains W17/W19 evidence.

title: Separate roster, depth, availability and participation state
decision: Treat these as distinct effective-dated observations, never one mutable player status.
evidence_basis: Source chat + recon roster/depth policy + W08

title: Position-aware player value without manual point assignments
decision: Register position-specific evidence interfaces; freeze no player/position point values.

title: Availability uses probability, effectiveness and expected usage scenarios
decision: Model multiple availability/limitation scenarios instead of only active/out.

title: Replacement effect is identity/value/usage specific
decision: Represent replacement candidate(s), redistributed usage and uncertainty; no fixed position penalty.

title: Sparse availability evidence remains uncertain
decision: Noncoverage/missing evidence is UNKNOWN; confidence/freshness/version remain explicit.

title: Rotation is first-class player state
decision: Support expected snap/opportunity distributions across multiple players, not starter-only depth.

title: Transfer preserves canonical player identity
decision: Transfers create effective-dated membership/role episodes under one W07 player ID.

title: Transfer translation is learned from continuous context
decision: Use same-player/position-aware historical design and continuous competition strength; forbid fixed conference penalties.

title: Freshmen/prospects use separate priors
decision: Zero-college-production players use prospect/recruiting/development priors with wide uncertainty.

title: Preseason honors are external-consensus candidates
decision: Preserve timestamped selector/honor evidence; freeze no manual honor bonus.

title: Draft outcomes are lagged evidence/training targets only
decision: Ban eventual draft outcomes as earlier roster features; permit prior completed development evidence and leakage-safe training targets.

title: Official conference availability is primary when policy covers

title: Refine Open-Meteo access governance and add ensemble mean as optional uncertainty research
decision: Record access lane/commercial-plan requirements; add SRC-062 ensemble mean/spread only as optional/research current-recent uncertainty evidence because historical depth is shallow.
notes: Does not promote weather ensemble features without empirical testing.

title: Keep the learned core architecture and carry target-hardware readiness condition into W25
decision: KEEP most major architectural boundaries, adopt only W24 provenance/PIT refinements, and require W25 final readiness to expose unresolved AC-038 if target evidence is still absent.
evidence_basis: W24 architecture challenge + cumulative tests + source refresh
notes: Avoids unnecessary pre-handoff churn.

title: Treat W25 as the terminal numbered wave and transition to implementation handoff
decision: No Wave 26 is created. The state after W25 is CODEX_IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF against the final canonical repository.
evidence_basis: REQ-001 exact-wave invariant; W25 final handoff objective
notes: Prevents accidental extension of the controlled wave program.

title: Freeze final maturity taxonomy and keep target-hardware readiness conditional
decision: Final documentation distinguishes implemented/functional starter/designed/awaiting data or validation/deferred states; AC-038 is not cleared without target evidence.
notes: Final handoff is not a production-performance claim.

title: Prioritize materialized chronological baseline evidence before advanced challengers or live modeling
decision: Post-wave implementation starts with source materialization, PIT replay and conventional baselines; advanced challenger/live work stays conditional/deferred.
evidence_basis: W17 protected evaluation; ADR-314; W24 architecture challenge
notes: Complexity must earn its place from empirical evidence.
